decision.reason: [ev-50ca4ae9b84b] is only a one-line changelog title that links to PR #6533. It hints that protection.Usages crossing namespaces without a "by" are now denied, but it does not give the API group, version or kind, the field path, or what "across namespace" means. It also does not say how the denial is enforced (admission rejection or reconcile failure) or what happens to existing Usages that match. The PR description or its docs/upgrade notes are needed to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
